result.description:
Australian Fishing Enterprises (AFE) is the largest exporter of Southern Bluefin Tuna in Australia. Our tuna is exported around the world for sale in international marketplaces as a premium sushi/sashimi product. We specialise in the fishing, ranching and grow out of Southern Bluefin Tuna and control the entire process from catching to feeding, harvesting, processing and delivery. 
This position is available from November 2026 or sooner for suitable candidates with a valid AMSA Near Coastal Marine Engine Driver Grade 2/3 Certification, for a placement for up to 4 years.
Vessel Engineer Duties:
The Employee will be required to perform certain duties as listed below whilst at Sea (offshore) and on the Farm Site (inshore), although this list is not exhaustive it is a generalised overview of duties.
Engineer Duties:
•	Engine Room Watchkeeping 
•	Periodical Engine Servicing
•	Maintain machinery to an Operational capacity
•	Use of Pumping Systems
•	Vessel Slipping and Docking
•	Vessel Maintenance/Repairs 
•	Vessel Crane Operation
•	Refuelling & Bunkering
•	Loading and Unloading of vessel at Sea and On-shore
•	Reporting to Vessel Master
•	Maintenance and repairs coordinated with Fleet Manager
•	Forklift operation on-shore only (if Licensed)
•	Fish Feeding 
•	Repetitive Manual labour 
•	Vessel cleaning and house keeping 
•	Vessel Mooring/Berthing 
•	Net mending 
•	Rope work (Splicing, Knotting etc.)
•	Farm Pontoon Maintenance
Also including Deck Hand duties:
Deckhand Duties:
•	Ability to stand on unstable surfaces and undertake general duties on a day-to-day basis as advised by the Master 
•	Forklift operation (only if Licensed from previous deployment on SWP)  onshore only
•	Loading and Unloading of vessel at Sea and On-shore
•	Deck Machinery Operation
•	Fish Feeding 
•	Fish Processing and Packing
•	Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
•	Repetitive Manual labour 
•	Vessel cleaning and house keeping 
•	Vessel Mooring/Berthing 
•	Net mending & Rope work (Splicing, Knotting etc.)
•	High Pressure Water Blasting
•	Painting by Hand and/or Spray
•	Farm Pontoon Maintenance
•	Portable hand tool use

The Employee will be required to perform the following additional duties whilst at Sea for Offshore Operations.
Navigation Watch:
• Keeping Lookout for other Vessels
• Maintaining Vessel Course as per Master’s instructions
• Vessel Log recording
• Watch Handover to next watch keeper
• Reporting to the Master
• Radio frequency monitoring
A Navigational watch can per performed at any time throughout the day or night, they are generally 1.5-2 hours in duration.

Additional Deck Duties:
• Tender vessel operation
• Launch and retrieval of tender
• Fish Sampling/Chumming
• Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
• Repetitive Manual labour
• Vessel cleaning and house keeping
• Vessel Mooring/Berthing
*This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.

Hours of operation are determined by the daily operational needs,.
January – July Operations are 7 days per week; you can work up to 6 days in a week. Up to 12 hours per day.
August to December Operations are 5 days per week Monday to Friday, you will work up to 5 days in a week, 8 hours per day.
Offshore Operations:
Tow & Support operations begin in December through to late March. If Quota is exhausted quickly the Offshore Operations will cease before late March.
Hours of operation whilst at Sea are from Sunrise to Sunset plus a navigational watch. 

Renumeration is paid as per the Award Rate, paid on a fortnightly basis. Farm work completed inshore and onshore will be calculated at the applicable hourly Farm rate. Aquaculture Award:(https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000114.html)(https://calculate.fairwork.gov.au/payguides/fairwork/ma000114/pdf)
OFFSHORE OPERATIONS
An additional contract is put in place alongside original Deckhand Contract to cover the periods Offshore for Tow & Support operations to classify Duties and Remuneration (there is no Award that covers the "At Sea" roles), contract renumeration is calculated from experience and seamanship knowledge.

This is not a FIFO position. Successful applicants will need to based in Port Lincoln for the duration of the contracted period.

 At Programmed, we believe our people are our greatest asset. We invest in career development, promote work-life balance, and provide a workplace where safety and wellbeing come first.

 Fantastic pay rates plus machining allowance 
 Regular overtime opportunities to maximise your earnings

 Leadership pathways with Leading Hand and Supervisor opportunities available

 Performing equipment repairs, maintenance overhauls and component rebuilds 
 Manual machining using conventional lathes and milling machines

From high-end custom kitchens and exclusive master closets to elegant libraries and unique home theatres, we are capable of turning your vision into a reality. We are seeking highly skilled Cabinet Makers to join our dedicated team of professionals.

As a Cabinet Maker you will fabricate, assemble, repair, and install custom wooden cabinetry, counters, and furniture. Interpret blueprints, operate woodworking machinery, and assemble components with precise hardware. The work involves selecting materials, applying finishes, and ensuring the final product meets both aesthetic and functional requirements.

Utilise and control CAD and CNC machines to precisely mark out, cut and shape components
Apply finishes to cabinetry and fittings for aesthetics
Apply protective coatings to cabinets and furniture fitting hinges, locks, catches, drawers, shelves and other associated hardware
Collaborate with clients and tradespeople for accurate installation
Install cabinetry and fittings in various areas as directed
Repair or refurbish damaged cabinetry and fittings

Trade qualified with proven experience in the same field
Knowledge in operating wide range of hand tools and power tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to meet tight deadlines without sacrificing workmanship
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks

Physically fit and able to lift large, heavy equipment and materials

Strong communication skills
Excellent reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!

Join the School of Electrical Engineering and Telecommunications in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW as a Lecturer or Senior Lecturer in a Teaching and Research role. You will contribute to research and teaching in digital electronics, FPGA design and embedded systems, while delivering high-quality teaching across undergraduate and postgraduate Electrical Engineering programs. You will also undertake research and scholarly activities that strengthen the School’s capabilities and contribute to high-impact outcomes across digital electronics systems and related areas of electrical engineering.

Position Details
• Salary:
o Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $133,065 to $156,864 per annum + 17% superannuation
o Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $161,619 to $185,422 per annum + 17% superannuation

Location: Campbellfield, VIC   Benefits   Career growth opportunities within a growing Australian caravan manufacturer  Hands-on engineering and product development experience  Supportive and collaborative team environment  Opportunity to work on innovative caravan designs and manufacturing projects  Stable full-time position with long-term career potential  $80,000 per annum + 12% superannuation          Task & responsibilities      Designing and developing caravan structures, chassis components, roof systems, wall assemblies, toolboxes, and custom mechanical components using engineering principles and CAD software including SolidWorks and Autodesk Inventor  Preparing and reviewing detailed 2D engineering drawings, 3D models, DXF files, STEP files, technical specifications, and manufacturing documentation for fabrication and production purposes  Developing specifications for manufacturing processes, materials, component layouts, structural assemblies, and fabrication requirements in accordance with project and production needs  Analysing production requirements, manufacturing processes, material utilisation, and operational workflows to improve manufacturing efficiency and product performance  Coordinating with suppliers, manufacturers, and fabrication companies regarding engineering specifications, material requirements, production schedules, and technical modifications  Assisting with project coordination including material planning, production scheduling, and monitoring fabrication progress to ensure project timelines are achieved  Supporting production and assembly teams by identifying and resolving engineering and manufacturing issues during fabrication and installation processes  Establishing and maintaining engineering standards, technical procedures, and quality control requirements in accordance with company standards and safety regulations  Conducting inspections and reviewing completed fabrication works to ensure compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, quality standards, and operational requirements  Participating in prototype development, testing, design validation, and continuous improvement activities to enhance product durability, structural integrity, and manufacturing efficiency  Collaborating with internal departments including production, purchasing, and management teams to support engineering operations and successful project delivery    Qualification & experience   Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field  Minimum 1–2 years of relevant experience in mechanical engineering, manufacturing, fabrication, or product design  Experience using CAD software including SolidWorks and Autodesk Inventor  Strong understanding of manufacturing, fabrication, and engineering processes  Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications  Strong communication, organisational, and problem-solving skills   About Company    Vacationer Caravans is an Australian caravan manufacturing company specialising in the design, development, and production of modern caravans and custom recreational vehicle solutions. The company is involved in caravan structural design, fabrication, manufacturing, assembly, and continuous product development, with a focus on quality, durability, and innovative design solutions for the Australian market.  Location: Campbellfield, VIC  The business works closely with suppliers, fabrication companies, and production teams to deliver high-quality caravan products and continuously improve manufacturing processes and product performance.       Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $80000-80000   Job Publish:  14-07-2026   Job Expire:  13-08-2026  Apply on:  MECHANICAL/DESIGN ENGINEER Job here!
